description: A Python teaching project compares simple and multiple regression for pollutant-removal efficiency using 350 simulated samples and operational input variables. This resource is provided by Mokhbi, Rabah. Its method is not tied to one place; geographic inputs and simulation resolution depend on the user configuration. The provider lists CSV, PNG, PY formats or archive containers, accessible through the linked landing page. Licence: CC-BY-4.0. The public page or repository can be accessed free of charge. Limitation: It was developed for a master's-level AI module. The synthetic exercise does not establish plant forecasting performance. For simulation, it can support model-based scenario analysis. Related catalogue record: model-iwa-benchmark-simulation-models. This is a thematic comparison, not evidence that the resource was used with that model.
